# Blocks of docs/quick-start.md the replay does not drive, and the catalog
# entries each of them quotes.
#
# TestTheQuickStartMatchesTheTool and
# TestEveryExemptBlockDeclaresTheCatalogEntriesItQuotes read this file. An
# exempt block is a block nothing runs, so every entry here is a finding rather
# than a line of configuration: it says a transcript a reader trusts is held by
# no replay. Five assertions keep the pressure on. An entry naming a block the
# replay does drive fails, so a stale entry is pruned rather than left to
# accumulate. An entry carrying no reason fails. An exempt block with no entry
# fails. An entry carrying neither quotes= nor quotes=none fails. And a
# quotes=none entry that does not say because what fails.
#
# An entry is the block's anchor, then key=value directives whose values may
# carry spaces: reason=, quotes=, and because=. The anchor is sha: and the
# first eight hex digits of the SHA-256 of the block's body lines joined by
# newlines, so an entry does not move when lines are added elsewhere in the
# document, and the failure naming an undeclared block prints the anchor to
# write. quotes= names the catalog keys whose stored text renders into the
# block, comma separated, and the declaration is maximal, so a key the
# discovery rule finds and the entry leaves out fails.
#
# An entry opening `inner` names a block whose marker-shaped lines are its
# content rather than fences, which the day somebody documents this document's
# own console grammar inside it will need: a four-backtick outer fence
# wrapping a three-backtick example is well formed, and the line scan behind
# the fence arithmetic has no state with which to see that. The document
# carries no nested fence today, so no such entry stands here.
